AntiPattern.Bad: `await expect(page).toMatchAriaSnapshot(\`- banner ... - main ... - contentinfo ...\`);` — full-page snapshot for a test that only verifies the checkout region.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Snapshot scope mismatched to test intent (`AX_E2E_SNAPSHOT_PARTIAL_BY_DEFAULT`). Any change to the unrelated banner / footer / sidebar produces a snapshot diff that has nothing to do with the test's contract. Maintenance cost balloons; signal-to-noise drops.
AntiPattern.Good: Scope to the region under test: `await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Checkout' })).toMatchAriaSnapshot(\`...\`);`.
